backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for an NFT platform managing collections, NFT items, user profiles, and minted tokens with role-based access control (admin/user) and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two implemented features: a hardcoded principal fallback for the admin button in Navigation, and suppression of the loading-then-false flash in the admin check hooks.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON summary file describing the purpose and key behavior of each frontend source file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including background, foreground, chart, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app, setting German language, viewport meta, and the Istvan Seidel light art portfolio title and description.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (gallery, artwork, upload, blog, NFT gallery/detail, admin) wrapped in a dark-mode ThemeProvider.
frontend/src/components/ActorErrorBanner: Error banner component displayed when the backend actor fails to initialize, showing a German error message and a retry button that triggers a page reload.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionF: Form component for creating or editing NFT collections, using create/update mutation hooks with validation, loading states, and German-language toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionL: Displays a list of NFT collections with edit and delete actions, using confirmation dialogs for deletion and a modal form for editing.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTForm.tsx: Form component for creating or updating an NFT, handling image upload with progress, collection selection, price input, and submission via create/update hooks.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTList.tsx: Renders a list of all NFTs with thumbnail, collection name, price badge, and edit/delete controls including a confirmation dialog for deletion.
frontend/src/components/ArtworkCard.tsx: Displays a single legacy artwork as a card with an image, title, and description, with hover scale and overlay animations.
frontend/src/components/BackendStatusInd: Small badge component that shows backend connectivity status (loading, online, or unreachable) based on a health check hook.
frontend/src/components/IssuedNFTCard.ts: Card component for a minted on-chain NFT showing image, token ID, mint date, owner principal, and optional 'my NFT' highlight for the current user.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main page layout wrapping children with a sticky header (logo, navigation, login button), an actor error banner, main content area, and a footer with backend status.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing loading state and toast notifications for auth events.
frontend/src/components/MintNFTModal.tsx: A modal dialog component for minting NFTs on ICP, handling image upload (with drag-and-drop), title/description input, upload progress, and success/error states.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Top-level navigation bar that renders route links and conditionally shows an Admin link (only after backend confirms admin status) plus a retry button on connection failure.
frontend/src/components/NFTBadge.tsx: A small badge component that displays a sparkle icon and 'NFT' label using the primary color scheme.
frontend/src/components/NFTCard.tsx: A card component that displays an NFT's image, title, collection name, price in ICP, and an optional ICP Explorer link.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionCar: A clickable card component linking to an external NFT collection marketplace (Getgems), showing a collection image with loading/error states, title, description, and a trade link.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionsSe: A section component that renders a static grid of seven NFT collection cards (Getgems/TON blockchain) with titles, descriptions, and preview images.
frontend/src/components/NFTDetailModal.t: A detail modal for an NFT showing its image, metadata (title, description, token ID, mint date, owner, price), copyable fields, and an ICP Explorer link.
frontend/src/components/NFTExplanation.t: An informational section component with cards explaining NFT concepts, automatic minting on ICP, and the ICP architecture to educate users.
frontend/src/components/NFTInfo.tsx: React component that displays NFT metadata (token ID, mint date, price) and a link to the ICP Explorer, with helpers to format timestamps and ICP prices.
frontend/src/components/PrincipalDisplay: Displays an ICP principal address (optionally shortened) with a tooltip showing the full value and a copy-to-clipboard button with toast feedback.
frontend/src/data/lightHealthBlogPosts.t: Defines a StaticBlogPost interface and exports an array of hardcoded German-language blog posts about light health, blue light, and red light therapy.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, initializing access control with an optional admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorReady.ts: Hook that exposes a boolean isActorReady flag and sets an error if the actor fails to initialize within 20 seconds.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendHealthCheck: React Query hook that pings the backend via getAllCollections() every 60 seconds to check connectivity, used by a status indicator component.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateBlogPost.ts: Stub mutation hook for blog post creation that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been removed in favor of the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCollection.t: Mutation hook that calls actor.addCollection() to create a new NFT collection and invalidates the collections query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateNFT.ts: Mutation hook that calls actor.addNFT() to create a new NFT, then fetches and returns the created item, with auth error parsing and query invalidation on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteCollection.t: Mutation hook that deletes an NFT collection by ID and invalidates both collections and NFT item queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteNFT.ts: Mutation hook that deletes an NFT by ID via the actor and invalidates the NFT items query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllArtworks.ts: Legacy hook stub that returns an empty array for artworks, preserving the interface while the old artwork backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllBlogPosts.ts: Legacy hook stub that returns an empty array for backend blog posts, allowing static blog posts to still render after the old blog backend was removed.
React Query hook that fetches all NFT collections from the backend actor, merging actor loading state into the returned isLoading flag.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllIssuedNFTs.t: React Query hook that fetches all issued NFTs via actor.listAllNFTs(), combining actor and query loading states.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllNFTs.ts: React Query hook that fetches all NFT items via actor.getAllNFTs(), combining actor and query loading states.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtwork.ts: Legacy hook that always returns null, as the old artwork backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtworksByCateg: Legacy hook that always returns an empty array, as the old artwork backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetBlogPost.ts: Legacy hook that always returns null, as the old blog backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: React Query hook that fetches the authenticated caller's user profile from the backend actor, only running when the user is authenticated and the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetMyIssuedNFTs.ts: React Query hook that fetches the list of NFTs issued by the currently authenticated user via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFT.ts: React Query hook that fetches a single NFT item by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFTsByCollectio: React Query hook that fetches all NFT items belonging to a specific collection from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context with login, logout, and status tracking using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposed via a React context provider and hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: React Query hook that checks whether the currently authenticated caller has admin permissions by calling the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdminWithT: Admin check hook with a phase-based state machine and configurable timeout, including a hardcoded principal fallback to handle slow or failing backend calls.
frontend/src/hooks/useMintNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that mints a new NFT via the backend actor and invalidates related query caches on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook that saves the caller's user profile to the backend actor and invalidates the profile cache on success.
Stub mutation hook that always throws an error, as the contact form backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateCollection.t: React Query mutation hook that updates an NFT collection's name and description via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that updates an NFT's metadata and image via the backend actor and invalidates the NFT items cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadArtwork.ts: Stub mutation hook that always throws an error, as the old artwork upload feature has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadImage.ts: Hook that handles image file validation, upload progress tracking, and uploading to the backend actor, returning the resulting ExternalBlob.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, configures Tailwind CSS, and defines a warm OKLCH-based design token palette for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that checks caller admin status with timeout phases and renders tabbed forms/lists for managing NFTs and collections.
frontend/src/pages/ArtworkDetail.tsx: Stub page for artwork detail that displays a 'not found' message since the old artwork backend was replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/pages/Blog.tsx: Blog listing page that merges static and backend blog posts, displaying them as clickable cards with admin controls for creating new posts.
frontend/src/pages/BlogCreate.tsx: Admin-only form page for creating new blog posts with title, content, and optional featured image upload.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPost.tsx: Single blog post detail page that resolves a post by ID from either static data or the backend and renders its content and featured image.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact form page with name, email, subject, and message fields that submits via the useSubmitContactForm hook with client-side validation.
frontend/src/pages/Gallery.tsx: Main gallery page displaying a hero banner, a static quote, and NFT collections with loading skeletons and error/retry handling.
frontend/src/pages/NFTDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single NFT, fetching it by ID from the URL and displaying its image, title, description, collection badge, price, and on-chain metadata with a back button to the gallery.
frontend/src/pages/NFTGallery.tsx: Gallery page listing all NFTs and issued NFTs with collection filtering, authentication-gated minting, and a detail modal; supports copy-to-clipboard for principal/canister IDs.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: Upload page that lets authenticated users create a new NFT by filling in title, description, price, collection, and an image file, then minting it on-chain with upload progress feedback.
frontend/src/utils/blogHelpers.ts: Utility functions for merging static and backend blog posts into a unified sorted list, finding a post by ID, and formatting timestamps as German-locale dates.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Async utility that copies a string to the clipboard using the Clipboard API with a textarea-based fallback for older browsers.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Utility functions to shorten or format an ICP principal string for display, truncating the middle with ellipsis.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routes, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts (Inter, Playfair Display), OKLCH-based semantic color tokens, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations; includes typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks project state for the Istvan Seidel NFT Portfolio web app, documenting a known issue where the admin button flashes and disappears on load due to unreliable backend isAdmin checks, along with existing fix features and a pending backend diagnostic request.
